text: Check that nanobanana-mcp tools are available before including generation recommendations
Analyze the site's existing image strategy for SEO impact
Evaluate OG image presence: Does og:image meta tag exist? Is it valid?
Evaluate OG image quality: Correct dimensions (1200x630 minimum), professional appearance?
Evaluate Schema images: Are ImageObject properties populated in structured data?
Evaluate Alt text quality: Descriptive, keyword-rich, not stuffed?
Evaluate Image format: Using modern formats (WebP, AVIF) vs legacy (PNG, JPEG)?
Evaluate Image file size: Under 200KB for hero, under 100KB for thumbnails?
Output Image Audit Summary with metrics table
Output Image Generation Plan with priority levels
Prioritize pages by traffic volume (highest traffic = fix first)
Note estimated cost for full generation plan
Recommend WebP conversion pipeline for all generated assets
If nanobanana-mcp is not available, still audit existing images but note that generation requires the banana extension
Report errors clearly with actionable next steps
Note data source as 'Image Audit (static analysis)' to distinguish from live checks
